# Software Verification Plan (SVP)
<!-- Generated by go-FuSa on 2026-06-19 — DO-178C §11.3 -->

## 1. Purpose

This Software Verification Plan defines the verification activities, methods,
independence requirements, and pass/fail criteria for go-DDS
(`github.com/SoundMatt/go-DDS`), developed as a SEOOC targeting ASIL-B / SIL 2 /
DAL-B. It complements `SAFETY_PLAN.md` (overall lifecycle) and the per-standard
gap reports (`iso26262-gap-report.json`, `iec61508-gap-report.json`,
`do178-gap-report.json`).

## 2. Verification Methods

| Method | Tool | Where it runs | DAL Applicability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Static analysis | `gofusa check`, `go vet`, `golangci-lint` | CI jobs `gofusa`, `lint`, `static-analysis` | DAL-A/B/C/D |
| Cybersecurity analysis | `gofusa cyber` (`cyber-report.json`) | CI job `gofusa` | DAL-A/B/C/D |
| Structural coverage | `gofusa coverage` (`coverage-report.json`) | local + CI coverage upload | DAL-A/B/C |
| Data/control coupling | `gofusa coupling` (`coupling-report.json`) | CI / release | DAL-A/B |
| Requirement-based testing | `go test -race` (244+ `//fusa:test` traced) | CI matrix `test-mock`, `test-rtps` | DAL-A/B/C/D |
| Fuzz testing | `go test -fuzz` | CI job `fuzz-short` | DAL-A/B/C |
| Wire interoperability | CycloneDDS interop, `relay interop` | CI jobs `test-interop`, `relay-conform` | DAL-A/B/C/D |

## 3. Independence

At DAL-A/B verification must be independent of the developer. go-DDS achieves
independence **structurally**: every verification gate above runs in CI
(GitHub Actions) on a protected `main` branch, not on the developer's
workstation. Merges require all required status checks to pass and are squash-
merged through pull request. The CI configuration is itself version-controlled
and changes to it are reviewed in the same PR flow. See `SAFETY_PLAN.md` §3.1 —
no separate human IV&V is claimed; the independent verifier is the CI tool
chain. Requirement-to-test traceability is enforced by `gofusa trace`
(244/244 traced+tested).

## 4. Coverage Objectives

| DAL | Statement | Decision | MC/DC |
|---|---|---|---|
| DAL-A | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| DAL-B | 100% | 100% | — |
| DAL-C | 100% | — | — |

Coverage measured by `gofusa coverage`.

go-DDS targets DAL-B: 100% statement and decision coverage are the objectives;
MC/DC is not required at DAL-B. Current measured coverage is recorded in
`coverage-report.json` and tracked per package (see README and the CI coverage
artifact). Code outside the safety perimeter (examples, dev tooling under
`cmd/`) is excluded from the coverage objective.

## 5. Regression Strategy

All unit, race, and fuzz tests re-run on every push and pull request via CI.
A change cannot merge to `main` unless the full required check set is green, so
regression detection is continuous rather than milestone-based.
